claim.claim-text: 1. A method (150) for navigating an unmanned aircraft (18) using pitch, comprising:

2. The method for navigating an unmanned aircraft using pitch of claim 1, in which orientating the camera on the unmanned aircraft to capture the field of view of the roof at the desired angle in relation to the roof comprises adjusting a gimbal to which the camera may be mounted on the unmanned aircraft and/or by changing a yaw, pitch and/or roll of the unmanned aircraft.

3. The method for navigating an unmanned aircraft using pitch of claim 1, comprising: moving the unmanned aircraft into a predetermined range (51) of image-capture distances (47) from the roof of the structure (21).

4. The method for navigating an unmanned aircraft using pitch of claim 3, comprising: receiving, by an autonomous flight management system within the unmanned aircraft, instructions to navigate the unmanned aircraft into the predetermined range of image-capture distances.
5. The method for navigating an unmanned aircraft using pitch of claim 1, comprising steps (158) of:
6. The method for navigating an unmanned aircraft using pitch of any one of claims 1 to 5, comprising steps (160) of:
7. The method for navigating an unmanned aircraft using pitch of claim 6, comprising repeating the steps (160) at a plurality of waypoints in a flightpath of the unmanned aircraft.

8. The method for navigating an unmanned aircraft using pitch of any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein determining (156) an image-capture distance (47) from the roof along the line of sight to the camera at the desired angle, based at least on the first distance and the pitch, is repeated at a plurality of waypoints in a flightpath of the unmanned aircraft.
9. The method for navigating an unmanned aircraft using pitch of any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the desired angle (53) is an oblique angle in relation to the roof.
10. The method for navigating an unmanned aircraft using pitch of claim 9, wherein the desired angle is based on a type of condition of the roof to be assessed.
11. The method for navigating an unmanned aircraft using pitch of claim 10, wherein the condition of the roof to be assessed is an amount or nature of hail damage.
12. The method for navigating an unmanned aircraft using pitch of any one of claims 1 to 11, comprising:

receiving Global Positioning System (GPS) location information regarding geographic location of the unmanned aircraft based on a Global Positioning System; and adjusting the GPS location information to obtain an actual location of the unmanned aircraft using a first sensor reading or a second sensor reading indicative of the first distance (41, 43) or second distance to the roof and real world coordinates of the roof.

13. The method for navigating an unmanned aircraft using pitch of claim 12, wherein the real world coordinates of the roof are obtained from a three dimensional model having real world coordinates of portions of the roof.
14. The method for navigating an unmanned aircraft using pitch of claim 12 or claim 13, comprising navigating the unmanned aircraft using the adjusted GPS location information.
15. One or more computer processors (24, 24, 27) configured to execute computer executable code to carry out any one of the methods for navigating the unmanned aircraft of claims 1 to 14.
